summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer report) announcing daily purchases of its ordinary shares under its existing buyback programme disclosed 31 July 2026. Goldman Sachs International acted as broker, buying about 32.9m shares on 2 October 2026 at a volume-weighted average of 102.79 pence, within a 101.45-103.80p range, following purchases of 33.9m, 34.5m, 10.8m and 30.8m shares on 28-30 September and 1 October. Cancellation is intended, reducing share count; no board recommendation or advisor named beyond the broker. Watch execution pace, cancellation cadence and any programme expansion or early termination, which could affect earnings-per-share accretion and capital-return expectations.
